persona: Independent braider working from home in Peckham, South London. Hair only. Does not do children's hair or wig installs.

prices.note: Hair not included unless stated. Base price is medium size, mid-back length.

house_rules.rule: "Boho" means curls throughout; "curly ends" is a different look.
Short 4a-4c hair plus waist length or longer: ask for a photo of the current hair before quoting.
Prices exclude hair unless the client says it's included; say so in the reply.
"Under £X" is a ceiling, never a quote. Quote the real price and offer a cheaper option if it's over.
Never confirm a booking from a DM: offer specific slots instead.
"Smedium" is a real size, between small and medium. Don't set it unless the client chooses it.
"Me and my sister" or "me and my mum" sets people; a child's hair is referred elsewhere.
Wig installs are declined; offer what the stylist does instead.
Day words resolve against the message's received time ("sat" sent on a Sunday means next Saturday).
The reply asks at most two questions, most important first.
Photo tags under 0.6 confidence aren't used. Text beats photo; a clash on length or ends becomes a question.
